data.body: AC amendment (gap G5): Disjointness assertion. check_dual_identity_complete MUST assert at return time that quarantine_keys ∩ {m.target for m in seed_repair_property_mutations} == set() — i.e., a key is either quarantined OR seeded, never both. Internal bug → raise InvariantClassificationError immediately rather than letting T4's post-emit filter silently drop a legitimate repair_property.
